Defect_Name: Lateral-Torsional Buckling Architecture and Moment Gradient Cb
Implementation_Mechanisms: Parabolic Cb evaluation via quarter-point Simpson formula with IS 800 Table 42 uniform lower bound (Cb=1.0) fallback; Enum selector; deprecation of unverified C1=1.75 to comparative field
Governing_Output_or_Metric: Cb = 1.2987; Mcr = 139.91 kNm; Md = 90.37 kNm; UR = 0.447 (Lower bound Cb=1.0: Mcr=107.73 kNm; Md=75.74 kNm; UR=0.534)
External_Standard_or_Literature: IS 800:2007 Annex E Eq (1) & Table 42; Kirby & Nethercot (1979); AISC 360-16 Eq (F1-1); Subramanian (2010)
Remaining_Technical_or_Physical_Conditio: Quarter-point formulation is an AISC/Kirby-Nethercot equivalent, not verbatim IS 800 Table 42 text. Misattributed in enum name. Both Cb=1.2987 and Cb=1.0 pass (UR <= 1.0).
Action_Required_For_Full_Closure: Formal independent structural peer review sign-off accepting the AISC quarter-point equivalent under IS 800:2007 framework.

Defect_Name: Fly-Bracing Series Restraint Stiffness and Diaphragm Transfer
Implementation_Mechanisms: Series-spring compliance model (strut + cleat flexure + bolt contact); purlin web flexure bypassed via full-depth cleat; mandatory HSFG M12 bolt pretensioning to eliminate slip
Governing_Output_or_Metric: K_sys = 10.72 kN/mm > K_req = 0.1234 kN/mm (86.9x reserve); F_brace = 4.969 kN; V_dsf = 17.00 kN (UR_slip = 0.292); Status: CONDITIONALLY_ADEQUATE
Remaining_Technical_or_Physical_Conditio: Claimed 86.9x stiffness margin relies on full-depth cleat bypassing 2 mm purlin web (if web in series, reserve drops to 5.0x). Hardcoded K_bolt=50 kN/mm lacks analytical derivation. Diaphragm stiffness unverified on site.
Action_Required_For_Full_Closure: Fabrication drawing confirming full-depth purlin web stiffener cleat; analytical derivation of K_bolt; on-site inspection of roof sheeting diaphragm screws.

Defect_Name: General 3D Weld Group Centroid and Multi-Axis Stress Solver
Implementation_Mechanisms: Parametric spatial weld solver evaluating transformed local moments of inertia (I0x, I0y, I0xy) for segments at arbitrary angle theta; evaluates global centroid, Ixx, Iyy, and product of inertia Ixy; 6-DOF elastic stress evaluation
Governing_Output_or_Metric: ISMB 300 contour weld: Aw = 4809 mm2; Zw = 442888 mm3; 3-DOF fe = 18.14 MPa; 6-DOF fe = 50.73 MPa <= fvwd = 189.37 MPa (UR = 0.268)
External_Standard_or_Literature: IS 800:2007 Clause 10.5.10; Blodgett (1966) Design of Welded Structures; Salmon & Johnson (1996)
Remaining_Technical_or_Physical_Conditio: Solver evaluates stresses at bounding box extrema (x_max, y_max) rather than true point-wise along actual weld segments. Valid for symmetric ISMB 300 contour weld, but approximate for arbitrary asymmetric profiles.
Action_Required_For_Full_Closure: Implement true point-wise segment stress integration engine before applying to asymmetric non-I-section weld topologies.
